claims.sourceText: DoD Office of Inspector General report DODIG-2026-045, reported 30 January 2026
claims.text: DODIG-2026-045, dated 21 January 2026, evaluated ten installations with drone incursions and interviewed officials from 31 DoD components and 4 federal agencies, finding inconsistent policies and approval processes that delayed counter-drone deployment.
